name: assets_commission_line
description: GH #3891 / REQ-751 (assets C10), docs/assets/asset-workflow-documents.md sections 1 and 2. One line of an asset commission: one asset card and a quantity. header_id is the record_id of the assets_commission header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry fk_assets_commission_line_header_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7, so a scoped read can filter lines). line_no is the position 1..n. asset_id is the record id of an assets_card. quantity is an exact decimal (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict); the value rule (whole number, 1 for fixed and intangible assets) is checked at issue. Written only by module assets; after issue nothing of a line changes.
